headers.//: The site loads nothing from a third-party origin, so the policy can be genuinely strict. 'unsafe-inline' is needed for style-src only because Astro inlines the stylesheet to save a round trip on slow connections. Scripts are same-origin files; the one inline <script> is application/ld+json, which is never executed and is still read from the DOM by crawlers.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

headers.//: Two years, subdomains included. Do not add 'preload' until the canonical domain is settled (PRD Q10) — preload lists are slow to undo.
The site asks for no device permissions at all. Geolocation is refused deliberately: branch choice is remembered client-side rather than prompted for (PRD Flow 4).
Content-hashed by filename change only, so cache hard. This is the single largest asset on a Burmese page.
Not content-hashed, so it must revalidate or a fix would not reach returning visitors.
